title: Integral geometric inverse image preserving flat-term K-flat complexes
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $X,Y$, a morphism $f:X\to Y$ with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes, and Chern data $c_Y,c_X$ [def-sp-tower-class-chern]. There exists $d:\operatorname{IntegralCoefficientPullback}(\ell,E,f,c_Y,c_X)$ [def-sp-tower-chern-pullback-intermediate] whose middle Kummer component at every positive level is the component of $\operatorname{unitsPull}(f)$ [lem-sp-tower-integral-class-pullback]. Moreover, if $P$ is a K-flat complex of $R_Y$-systems [def-pc-kflat-complex], all of whose terms are flat sheaves on the vertical sequence site [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then the termwise inverse image $d^*P$ is K-flat over $R_X$. Here $R_T=(\mathbf Z/\ell^{n+1})_n$ with its actual quotient transitions. The two integral forgetful, coefficient-unit and root comparisons and all their equations are those in the definition of $d$. No scalar comparison for the $A$-coefficient tower is asserted.

proof.text: Construct each integral constant-ring comparison with the generic constant-sheaf inverse-image comparison (at the actual ULift ZMod universe). Use the finite algebraic inverse-image construction and naturality of constant comparison to identify adjacent quotient maps. Finite limits follow from algebraic inverse image and colimits from the actual module adjunction. Apply ordinaryInverseSystem_exists to assemble the exact additive whole-system functor.

proof.text: Use integralInverseSystem_normalization for the underlying abelian square, coefficient-unit isomorphism and integer-generator normalization. An additive map between modules over the integral constant quotient sheaf is linear: locally every scalar is an integer, and additive maps preserve integer multiplication. Use the proved undoRestriction helper to transfer these finite linear maps across the evaluation ring identification. The Forget section, restriction, transition and morphism equations therefore show its full faithfulness, so abelian isomorphisms uniquely lift to module-system isomorphisms.

proof.text: Construct the full-units maps directly from unitsPull in the middle and last positions. Adjunction and the explicit section formulas show that restriction of roots commutes with inclusion into units; integer power maps commute with every additive map. The root comparison is invertible by cartesianness when l is invertible. Lift its conjugate by the underlying square and rootForget through the fully faithful integral Forget, and cancel the isomorphisms to obtain kummer_roots. Assemble IntegralCoefficientPullback from these maps and retain the actual middle-component equality.

theorem integralCoefficientPullback_exists
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (cY : Chern l E Y) (cX : Chern l E X) :
    ∃ d : IntegralCoefficientPullback l E f cY cX,
      (∀ n : ℕ, d.kummer.τ₂.app (Opposite.op n) =
        (unitsPull f).app (Opposite.op n)) ∧
      (∀ (P : CochainComplex (Systems Y (Rrings l Y)) ℤ),
          CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
            (R := WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing
              (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).obj (Opposite.op n))
                (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)) P →
          (∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite
            (J := WeilConjectures.coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y))
            (R := WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing
              (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).obj (Opposite.op n))
                (fun n ↦ (Rrings l Y).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)) (P.X i)) →
          CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
            (R := WeilConjectures.SemilinearSections.systemRing
              (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (fun n ↦ (Rrings l X).obj (Opposite.op n))
                (fun n ↦ (Rrings l X).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op))
            ((d.pull.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
